name: Proteus Electronics Projects
tagline: 15 electronics and embedded projects designed and simulated in Proteus: traffic signals for 8 junctions, water tank control, smart street lights, parking and more.
highlights: Traffic light controller with field install guides for 8 sites
Water tank level controller with dry-run protection
Gas / smoke detector that sends SMS
Smart street light, parking system, railway crossing
